import json, pathlib, sys

assert R.SUBAGENT_FIELDS == ("calls", "tokens") and "subagents" in R.OBSERVATION_OPTIONAL_FIELDS
def find(node):
    if isinstance(node, dict):
        if isinstance(node.get("properties"), dict) and "subagents" in node["properties"]:
            return node["properties"]["subagents"]
        node = list(node.values())
    if isinstance(node, list):
        for v in node:
            hit = find(v)
            if hit:
                return hit
    return None

import importlib.machinery as M, os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, unittest.mock

tmp = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()).resolve()
try:
    repo = tmp / "repo"
    repo.mkdir()
    home = tmp / "home"
    home.mkdir()
    def git(*a):
        return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *a], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    git("init", "-q")
    git("config", "user.email", "t@example.invalid")
    git("config", "user.name", "t")
    (repo / "README.md").write_text("hi\n")
    git("add", ".")
    git("commit", "-qm", "init")
    (repo / ".git" / "info").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (repo / ".git" / "info" / "exclude").write_text("# base\n")
    with unittest.mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"HOME": str(home)}):
        before = R.protected_snapshot(repo)
        (repo / ".git" / "info" / "exclude").write_text("# base\nscripts/\n")
        git("update-index", "--skip-worktree", "README.md")
        after = R.protected_snapshot(repo)
    assert before.get(".git/info/exclude") != after.get(".git/info/exclude"), "exclude change not seen"
    assert ".git/index-flags/README.md" not in before and after.get(".git/index-flags/README.md") == "flag:S", after
finally:

import subprocess, sys
hogs = [subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-c', 'while True: pass']) for _ in range(4)]
tests = ['WrapperIntegration.test_stall_watchdog_stops_silent_providers_for_worker_and_brain', 'WrapperIntegration.test_runner_and_wrappers_refuse_negative_and_non_finite_timing_values', 'WrapperIntegration.test_workspace_lock_spans_provider_and_receipt_then_releases']
passes = 0
try:
    for i in range(5):
        rc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'tests/test-execution-integration.py', *tests]).returncode
        print('run', i + 1, 'rc', rc, flush=True)
        passes += rc == 0
finally:
    for h in hogs:
        h.kill()
        h.wait()
print(passes, 'of 5 passed under load')
sys.exit(0 if passes == 5 else 1)
